gbm_population_evidence.quote: For Cohort A, must have evidence of relapsed or refractory non-brainstem CNS tumor

gbm_population_flag.reason: Paediatric-oriented CNS tumour trial (age up to 21, CHILD and ADULT); glioblastoma only appears in conditions; could alternatively be coded basket_gbm_eligible or not_glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Autologous T cells transduced with a lentiviral vector expressing a B7-H3-CAR with a CD28z signaling domain and 41BB ligand (B7-H3-CAR T cells).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Cohort A: relapsed/refractory non-brainstem CNS primary tumor AND tumor is B7-H3 positive

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To determine the maximum tolerated dose for the locoregional delivery of autologous B7-H3-CAR T cells

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess the efficacy, defined as sustained objective response, partial response (PR) or complete response (CR)

role_evidence.quote: Four (4) infusions of B7-H3-CAR T cells will be locoregionally administered via CNS reservoir catheter.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous B7-H3-directed CAR T cell therapy (cell therapy)

source_quote.quote: Cohort A: relapsed/refractory non-brainstem CNS primary tumor AND tumor is B7-H3 positive
OR H3K27-altered diffuse midline pontine glioma

coder_notes: Only intervention is CAR T cell therapy (excluded type), so no candidate. B7-H3 is the CAR target but the agent is not a candidate, so candidate_matched is false. Adult/paediatric (age <=21) mixed CNS tumour trial.
